_about: lanePITCLIPS: Pitborn's 4 missing attack rows + dodge_diveroll baked from his OWN pack clips (combat_clips_unity role attack_1..5) and a neutral Mixamo library dive roll onto Pitborn_combat.glb's 106-joint tree. Same tool/maths as laneCLIPBUILD2 clip_sets.py (plain retarget + shared leg fix). No Dracula file, no posture rows (Pitborn's live attacks are not posture-baked; maul is two-handed so the sword blade-aim rows do not apply).
